sec: sec:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Appointing qualified third-party assessors. Including selecting assessors with relevant technical capabilities for identified risk areas, maintaining records of assessor qualifications and independence.

sentences.text: Including selecting assessors with relevant technical capabilities for identified risk areas, maintaining records of assessor qualifications and independence.

blocks.id: blk:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Conducting regular testing. Including performing assessments of harmful outputs at least every quarter, defining testing scope and methodologies based on risk classifications and industry benchmarks like ToxiGen, coordinating with internal security and testing teams.

sentences.text: Including performing assessments of harmful outputs at least every quarter, defining testing scope and methodologies based on risk classifications and industry benchmarks like ToxiGen, coordinating with internal security and testing teams.

blocks.id: blk:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Maintaining documentation. Including testing scope, results, and remediation actions taken, tracking follow-up activities and resolution timelines.

sentences.text: Including testing scope, results, and remediation actions taken, tracking follow-up activities and resolution timelines.
